verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs as a hosted, headless reviewer in the PR pipeline. It reviews automatically in the background on every PR update across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, and can be triggered by comment commands. A community user also drives it on request from a GitHub Action. However, there is no documented CLI, API or CI-step invocation for running it inside arbitrary pipelines. Missing for 10: a documented CLI/API for invoking Bugbot from CI jobs, status-check or exit-code gating for automation, and first-party docs on programmatic triggering beyond PR comments.
